title: Number of Employees Who Met the Target
summary: Given a 0-indexed array hours of non-negative integers representing the number of hours each of the n employees has worked, and a non-negative integer target representing the minimum required hours of work, return the count of employees who have worked at least the target number of hours.
statement: Given a 0-indexed array hours of non-negative integers representing the number of hours each of the n employees has worked, and a non-negative integer target representing the minimum required hours of work, return the count of employees who have worked at least the target number of hours.
constraints: hours[i] is the study time completed by employee i.
Count employees whose hours are at least target.
reference_solution:
def employees_meeting_target(hours,target):
    return sum(value>=target for value in hours)
hints: Each employee can be classified independently.
Compare every hours value with the inclusive threshold.
In Python true contributes one and false zero, so the sum is exactly the qualifying count.

tests.explanation: Employees with two, three, and four hours meet the target, giving three.
Both values equal the inclusive target, so both count.
